sentences.text: Maria Yuryevna Sharapova -LRB- Мари́я Ю́рьевна Шара́пова ; born April 19 , 1987 -RRB- is a Russian professional tennis player .	Russian	Russians	tennis	tennis

A United States resident since 1994 , Sharapova has competed on the WTA tour since 2001 .	United States	United States	United States resident	Permanent residence (United States)	WTA	Women's Tennis Association
She has been ranked world No. 1 in singles by the WTA on five separate occasions , for a total of 21 weeks .	WTA	Women's Tennis Association	world No. 1	List of WTA number 1 ranked players
She is one of ten women , and the only Russian , to hold the career Grand Slam .	Russian	Russians	career Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)#Career Grand Slam	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)

She is also an Olympic medalist , having earned silver for Russia in women 's singles at the 2012 Summer Olympics in London .	2012	2012 French Open – Women's Singles	Olympic medalist	Olympic medalist	silver	Olympic silver medal	2012 Summer Olympics	2012 Summer Olympics

Sharapova became the world No. 1 for the first time on August 22 , 2005 , at the age of 18 , and last held the ranking for the fifth time for four weeks from June 11 , 2012 , to July 8 , 2012 .	2012	2012 French Open – Women's Singles	world No. 1	List of WTA number 1 ranked players

Her 35 singles titles and five Grand Slam titles -- two at the French Open and one each at the Australian Open , Wimbledon , and US Open -- rank third among active players , behind Serena and Venus Williams .	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)	French Open	French Open	Australian Open	Australian Open	Wimbledon	The Championships, Wimbledon	US Open	US Open (tennis)	Serena	Serena Williams	Venus Williams	Venus Williams
She won the year-ending WTA Finals in her debut in 2004 .	2004	2004 US Open – Mixed Doubles	WTA	Women's Tennis Association	WTA Finals	WTA Finals
She has also won three doubles titles .
Despite an injury-prone career , Sharapova has achieved a rare level of longevity in the women 's game .

She won at least one singles title a year from 2003 until 2015 , a streak only bested by Steffi Graf , Martina Navratilova , and Chris Evert .	2003	2003 US Open – Women's Doubles	Steffi Graf	Steffi Graf	Martina Navratilova	Martina Navratilova	Chris Evert	Chris Evert

Several tennis pundits and former players have called Sharapova one of tennis 's best competitors , with John McEnroe calling her one of the best the sport has ever seen .	tennis	tennis	John McEnroe	John McEnroe
Sharapova has been featured in a number of modeling assignments , including a feature in the Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Issue .	Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Issue	Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Issue
She appeared in many advertisements , including those for Nike , Prince , and Canon , being the face of several fashion houses , most notably Cole Haan .	Cole Haan	Cole Haan

Since February 2007 , she has been a United Nations Development Programme Goodwill Ambassador , concerned specifically with the Chernobyl Recovery and Development Programme .	United Nations Development Programme Goodwill Ambassador	UNDP Goodwill Ambassador	Chernobyl Recovery and Development Programme	Chernobyl Recovery and Development Programme

In June 2011 , she was named one of the `` 30 Legends of Women 's Tennis : Past , Present and Future '' by Time and in March 2012 was named one of the `` 100 Greatest of All Time '' by Tennis Channel .	2012	2012 French Open – Women's Singles	Time	Time (magazine)	100 Greatest of All Time	100 Greatest of All Time	Tennis Channel	Tennis Channel
According to Forbes , she has been named highest paid female athlete in the world for 11 consecutive years and earned 285 million including prize money since she turned pro in 2001 .	Forbes	Forbes

In March 2016 , Sharapova revealed she had failed a drug test at the 2016 Australian Open on January 26 , 2016 .	Australian Open	Australian Open	drug test	drug test	2016 Australian Open	2016 Australian Open

She had tested positive for meldonium , a substance that had been banned , effective January 1 , 2016 by the World Anti-Doping Agency -LRB- WADA -RRB- .	meldonium	meldonium	World Anti-Doping Agency	World Anti-Doping Agency

On June 8 , 2016 , she was suspended from playing tennis for two years by the International Tennis Federation -LRB- ITF -RRB- .	tennis	tennis	International Tennis Federation	International Tennis Federation
On October 4 , 2016 , the suspension was reduced to 15 months , starting from the date of the failed test .
She returned to the WTA tour on April 26 , 2017 at the Porsche Tennis Grand Prix .	WTA	Women's Tennis Association	Porsche Tennis Grand Prix	2017 Porsche Tennis Grand Prix
